t: You're on Kensington Park Gardens, a residential street in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Caroline Croom Robertson died here in 1892. She was a British suffragist and college administrator, first secretary and later bursar of Girton College, Cambridge, the first university college in England to admit women. Her work was the practical, behind-the-scenes kind that helped a pioneering college to run and to last.
